# MIKA5

> Free AI desktop app that runs 100% on your computer. Local RAG, projects, per-chat knowledge, vision models. Powered by Ollama.

MIKA5 Community 0.3.2 runs on Windows 10+, macOS 12+ and Linux. It is free and distributed under AGPL-3.0.

## Pages

- [MIKA5 — AI on your machine. Under your control.](https://mika5.xyz/): Product overview, features, download instructions and frequently asked questions.
- [MIKA5 Model Guide](https://mika5.xyz/models.html): How to choose local AI models for MIKA5: exact Ollama tags, verified download sizes, hardware requirements and use cases. No benchmark scores.
- [MIKA5 White Paper](https://mika5.xyz/whitepaper.html): Technical white paper for MIKA5 Community v0.3.1: Electron architecture, local SQLite storage, local RAG engine, optional cloud adapters with explicit consent, security design and AGPL-3.0 distribution.

## En español

- [MIKA5 — IA en tu máquina. Bajo tu control.](https://mika5.xyz/es/): La portada en español: funciones, descarga, primeros pasos y preguntas frecuentes.
- [Guía de modelos de MIKA5](https://mika5.xyz/es/models.html): Cómo elegir modelos de IA locales para MIKA5: etiquetas de Ollama, tamaños de descarga, requisitos de hardware y casos de uso.
- [White Paper de MIKA5](https://mika5.xyz/es/whitepaper.html): Documento técnico de MIKA5 Community v0.3.1: arquitectura, almacenamiento local, motor RAG, adaptadores cloud opcionales con consentimiento y diseño de seguridad.
